## Propriétaires et commandes

- Inventaire des commandes : CLI.md à la racine du monorepo ; consulter --help du binaire installé.
- Kernel OS : `aphrody-kernel tools`, `aphrody-kernel call <outil> '<JSON>'`, `aphrody-kernel mcp`.
- Nushell : `nu_eval` reçoit code/cwd/vars ; transmettre les données via vars. Cet outil peut modifier le système.
- Git : `github_status` reçoit repo_path ; sa liste de modifications ne prouve pas leur auteur.
- Agent Home : crates/ai/agent-home ; génération : packages/infra/workspace/src/agent-home.ts.
- Sessions externes : crates/ai/session/src/external ; mémoire : crates/ai/memory.
- A2A : tools/config/a2a-peers.json ; transport : crates/os/kernel/comps/a2a-coord ; contrat : crates/contracts/a2a.
- Modèles locaux : crates/ai/llama-server et crates/ai/models ; ne pas déplacer les poids.
- Contrôles Rust : cargo check/clippy/test sur les packages modifiés ; Bun : oxlint/oxfmt, tsgo, bun test selon manifests.

## Séparation des domaines et collaboration

Choisir un profil avant le lancement : ~/.aphrody/workspaces/aphrody, dbfr ou ie.
APHRODY_WORKSPACE désigne le profil Agent Home ; le cwd de travail reste la racine de code du domaine.
Claude, Codex, agy et modèles locaux partagent les règles et le contexte uniquement au sein du domaine choisi.
Les règles du dépôt (AGENTS.md, et projections CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md) restent applicables.
Partager une branche exige de vérifier branche et HEAD avant chaque tâche ; réserver les fichiers et désigner un intégrateur Git.
Ne pas créer de worktree/branche isolée pour ce mode ; ne pas attribuer une modification Git à un PID sans preuve.

`aphrody ai sync-sessions --watch --interval-secs 30 --json` existe ; son mode historique agrège tous les agents.
Avec APHRODY_AGENT_DOMAIN=aphrody|dbfr|ie, le miroir et la mémoire utilisent le profil choisi ; les sessions non marquées sont exclues.
Les associations PID/session historiques fondées sur cwd et mtime sont heuristiques si plusieurs sessions partagent un cwd.
Les conversations natives restent dans leurs stores privés ; le miroir filtré exige le marqueur de domaine du premier tour utilisateur.
Pour dbfr/Shenron, le dossier synchronisé Google Drive conserve corpus/poids et entraînements ; vérifier le mapping privé avant de lancer.

| `dragonball.canon_references` | Corpus de preuves de canonicité (déclarations de Toriyama, planches de databooks traduites), filtrable par q et provenance. API : site /api/canon/references. |
| `dragonball.chronologie` | La frise officielle dans son ordre éditorial (épisodes, films, tomes) ; ne pas la reconstruire par dates de diffusion. Filtres era et kind. API : site /api/chronologie. |
| `dragonball.data_coverage` | Couverture réelle : passages par corpus et par type, modèle d'embeddings, date de l'index, nombre de fiches par rubrique du wiki. Une recherche vide sur un corpus absent ne prouve rien. API : bot /api/public/data/coverage. |
| `dragonball.databooks_get` | Détail d'un guide, artbook ou interview : métadonnées, couverture, planches transcrites (maxPages défaut 50). API : site /api/databooks/{id}. |
| `dragonball.databooks_planches` | Cherche une expression dans la transcription des planches et rend ouvrage, planche et extrait autour du terme. API : site /api/databooks/search. |
| `dragonball.databooks_scanlate` | Analyse une planche databook via le CDN et Koharu : régions détectées, OCR, traduction, calque de nettoyage et export PSD. Requiert la fonctionnalité Koharu et ses modèles. |
| `dragonball.databooks_search` | Recherche parmi les fiches d'ouvrages (titre, auteur, description) avec couverture et nombre de planches ; ne lit pas le texte des planches (voir databooks_planches). API : site /api/databooks. |
| `dragonball.manga_chapitre` | Un chapitre planche par planche : transcription et URL de lecture ; texteSeul (défaut vrai) omet les URL d'images. API : site /api/manga/chapter/{id}. |
| `dragonball.manga_page` | Métadonnées et URL d'image d'une planche (coordonnées OCR series/tome/planche). API : bot /api/public/manga/page. |
| `dragonball.manga_planche` | Une planche d'un chapitre : image, transcription OCR, bulles, voisines et URL de lecture. API : site /api/manga/chapter/{id}/planche/{n}. |
| `dragonball.manga_recherche` | Cherche un texte dans les transcriptions et rend des planches citables avec URL de lecture (limit ≤ 100). API : site /api/manga/search. |
| `dragonball.manga_scanlate` | Analyse une planche manga via le CDN et Koharu : régions détectées, OCR, traduction, calque de nettoyage et export PSD. Requiert la fonctionnalité Koharu et ses modèles. |
| `dragonball.manga_search` | Recherche textuelle (OCR) dans les planches du manga Dragon Ball (limit ≤ 50). API : bot /api/public/manga/search. |
| `dragonball.manga_tomes` | Liste les tomes du manga, ou le détail d'un tome (avec ses planches) si series et tome sont fournis. API : bot /api/public/manga/tomes. |
| `dragonball.news` | Dernières actualités Dragon Ball de dragonballfr.com (limit ≤ 50). API : bot /api/public/news. |
| `dragonball.rag_ask` | Question en langage naturel : le RAG sélectionne les passages (hits, avec url) et le LLM rédige answer dans la voix du bot unique (persona Akira Toriyama par défaut en YOLO). Si le LLM est indisponible l'API répond une erreur. local=true utilise le modèle du contrat APHRODY_AI_* et le corpus local. API : bot /api/public/rag/chat. |
| `dragonball.rag_context` | Passages les plus pertinents en texte intégral, numérotés [n] avec leur URL absolue, dans un budget maxChars (défaut 6000). Mêmes filtres que rag_search. API : bot /api/public/rag/context. |
| `dragonball.rag_search` | Recherche hybride (BM25 + embeddings, fusion RRF, reranking) dans la base Dragon Ball de dragonballfr.com (manga, databooks, Kanzenshuu, wiki). Renvoie des passages sourcés (rowid, kind, title, url, snippet, score) et le mode effectif. Filtres lang, entity, sourceId, kind. local=true (ou SHENRON_LOCAL_RAG=1) interroge le corpus local Aphrody. API : bot /api/public/rag/search. |
| `dragonball.sources` | Liste les sources/corpus indexés par le RAG Dragon Ball (manga, databooks, Kanzenshuu…). API : bot /api/public/sources. |
| `dragonball.wiki_categories` | Registre des catégories du wiki : name, label, total. API : bot /api/public/wiki/categories. |
| `dragonball.wiki_get` | Détail d'une entité du wiki par identifiant numérique ou slug. API : bot /api/public/wiki/{category}/{idOrSlug}. |
| `dragonball.wiki_list` | Liste paginée des entités d'une catégorie du wiki avec son total. API : bot /api/public/wiki/{category}. |
| `dragonball.wiki_search` | Recherche plein-texte dans le wiki Dragon Ball ; résultats {category, id, slug, title, snippet} à ouvrir avec dragonball.wiki_get. API : bot /api/public/wiki/search. |
| `enable_scheduled_task` | Enables a scheduled task via schtasks /Change /Enable. |
| `firefly_generate` | Generate image(s) with Adobe Firefly Services (v3, async). OAuth server-to-server: set FIREFLY_CLIENT_ID and FIREFLY_CLIENT_SECRET in the environment. Cross-platform, headless cloud API (no Photoshop install). Optionally save to a directory. Returns { count, outputs:[{ seed, content_type, bytes, saved_path? }] }. |
| `firefly_generative_expand` | Generative expand (Adobe Firefly v3): enlarge an image's canvas to width×height, AI-filling the new area (optional prompt). image_url must be Adobe-readable. Optionally save_dir. Returns { count, image_urls, saved_paths }. Set FIREFLY_CLIENT_ID/SECRET. |
| `firefly_generative_fill` | Generative fill (Adobe Firefly v3): replace the masked region of an image with prompt-guided content. image_url + mask_url (white = fill) must be Adobe-readable. Optionally save_dir. Returns { count, image_urls, saved_paths }. Set FIREFLY_CLIENT_ID/SECRET. |
| `firefly_to_photoshop` | Bridge: generate an image with Adobe Firefly, then route it through the cloud Photoshop API. With output_url it converts the result to that URL/format (e.g. an editable PSD); without it, returns the layer manifest of the generated image. Set FIREFLY_CLIENT_ID/SECRET. |
| `gamepad_create_xbox360` | Allocates a virtual Xbox 360 controller via ViGEmBus and connects it to the system. The virtual controller is indexed by slotIndex (0–7). Returns {"success":true,"slot":N,"vendorId":"045e","productId":"028e"} on success. Requires ViGEmBus: https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmBus/releases |
| `gamepad_destroy` | Removes and frees the virtual Xbox 360 controller at the given slot. Safe to call if the slot was never created (no-op). |
| `gamepad_destroy_all` | Removes and frees ALL active virtual Xbox 360 controllers created in this process. Use as cleanup before shutdown or when resetting gamepad state. |
| `gamepad_environment` | Diagnoses the ViGEmBus virtual gamepad environment. Reports whether ViGEmBus registry key exists, whether the service is running, and whether ViGEmClient.dll can be located on disk. Install ViGEmBus from https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmBus/releases if absent. |
| `gamepad_press_button` | Presses one or more buttons on a virtual Xbox 360 controller then releases them. buttonMask uses the same bitmask as GamepadSendXbox360State. holdMs: how long to hold the buttons down (clamped to [1, 5000] ms). |
| `gamepad_send_xbox360_state` | Sends a full Xbox 360 controller state update. buttons bitmask: DPAD_UP=1, DPAD_DOWN=2, DPAD_LEFT=4, DPAD_RIGHT=8, START=16, BACK=32, L3=64, R3=128, LB=256, RB=512, GUIDE=1024, A=4096, B=8192, X=16384, Y=32768. Axes lx/ly/rx/ry: [-32768, 32767]. Triggers lt/rt: [0, 255]. |
| `gcp_status` | Inspect Google Cloud Platform credentials, active project, and Gemini API key availability |
| `gcp_storage_list` | List objects and storage prefixes in a Google Cloud Storage bucket |
| `get_active_power_plan` | Returns the GUID and friendly name of the active Windows power plan. |
| `get_clipboard_text` | Reads UTF-16 text content from the Windows clipboard. |
| `get_cpu_info` | Returns CPU topology as JSON: logical processors, physical cores, NUMA nodes, cache sizes (L1/L2/L3 aggregate), architecture. |
| `get_cpu_usage` | Samples global CPU usage over a short interval (default 250 ms, clamp 50-2000) via GetSystemTimes. Returns usage/idle percent and raw idle/kernel/user deltas in seconds. Kernel time as reported by Windows INCLUDES idle time; this tool subtracts it before computing the percentage. |
| `get_defender_status` | Returns Windows Defender state as JSON: AntivirusEnabled, RealTimeProtectionEnabled, BehaviorMonitorEnabled, TamperProtected, AntivirusSignatureVersion, LastQuickScanStartUtc, LastFullScanStartUtc, ThreatCount. |
| `get_disk_info` | Returns logical-drive info (root, type, total/free/available bytes) as JSON via GetLogicalDriveStrings + GetDiskFreeSpaceEx. |
| `get_file_info` | Returns metadata for a file or directory as JSON: size, dates, type, hidden flag. |
| `get_gpu_preferences` | Reads all per-app GPU preferences from HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences. Returns each registered exe path with its raw preference string ('GpuPreference=N;'). |
| `get_hags_mode` | Reads HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers\HwSchMode. 0 = WDDM CPU scheduling, 1 = OS-managed default, 2 = Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling. Requires WDDM 2.7+ (Win10 20H1+ / Win11). Reboot to take effect. |
| `get_memory_info` | Returns physical / virtual / page-file memory state as JSON via GlobalMemoryStatusEx. |
| `get_network_adapters` | Lists network adapters (Name, Description, Status, MAC, link speed, IPv4 addresses) as JSON. |
| `get_os_info` | Returns OS version info (ProductName, EditionId, DisplayVersion, BuildNumber, UBR, InstallationType, OSArchitecture, MachineName, UserName) as JSON. |
| `get_registry_value` | Reads a registry value. Path uses PowerShell-style hive prefixes (HKCU:\, HKLM:\, HKCR:\, HKU:\, HKCC:\). |
| `get_system_profile` | Récupère le profil système complet pour vérifier l'état d'optimisation du poste. |
| `git_ingest` | Ingest any Git repository or directory into a prompt-ready LLM digest matching https://gitingest.com/llms.txt (token estimation, ASCII tree, delimited file contents) |
| `github_branches` | List local and tracking remote branches with upstream synchronization status |
| `github_docs_search` | Search GitHub repositories intelligently for documentation, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and prompt-ready digests. Discovers authoritative open-source repositories matching the query, inspects llms.txt and README, and optionally generates full GitIngest digests. |
| `github_status` | Inspect current branch, ahead/behind tracking, modified/untracked files and recent commits for a Git repository |
| `github_tree` | List tree entries (blobs, trees, sizes) at a specific Git reference or path |
| `golang_scan` | Inspects a target binary for Golang runtime signatures (pclntab) and extracts Go package/symbol indicators. Passive inspection without execution. |
| `infra_exec` | Execute an arbitrary remote command on an Aphrody infrastructure host (vps or dbfr) via in-process SSH |
| `infra_git_status` | Inspect the working tree status and recent commits of a production Git repository on an infrastructure host |
| `infra_sftp_list` | List directory entries and metadata (size, permissions, is_dir) on an Aphrody infrastructure host via native SFTP |
| `infra_sftp_read` | Read the content of a remote file on an Aphrody infrastructure host via native in-process SFTP |
| `infra_sync` | Execute a differential file/directory synchronization with remote infrastructure host (fast-rsync/rclone) |
| `keyboard_hold` | Holds an arbitrary virtual key down (no release). Pair with KeyboardRelease to let go. Useful for charging mechanics, sustained movement keys, modifiers held across multiple ops. |
| `keyboard_release` | Releases a virtual key previously held by KeyboardHold. |
| `keyboard_scan_code` | Sends a single key by raw hardware SCAN CODE instead of virtual key. Some games (and anti-cheats) ignore Send-Input from virtual keys but accept scan codes because they match real keyboards. action: 'down' \| 'up' \| 'tap' (down+up). |
| `kill_process` | Kills a process by PID (preferred) or name. Returns the count of terminated processes. Force=true requests an immediate kill (default true). PPL-protected processes return a labelled error. |
| `launch_app` | Launches a Windows application. Accepts an absolute path to an .exe (e.g. 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\notepad.exe'), an executable name resolvable via PATH (e.g. 'notepad.exe'), or a shell URI (mailto:, explorer:, ms-settings:). |
| `list_directory` | Lists directory contents as streamed JSON. Set recursive=true to descend, showHidden=true to include hidden entries, pattern to filter by glob. Hard cap: 10000 entries returned; result is marked truncated when exceeded. |
| `list_listening_ports` | Lists TCP/IPv4 listening ports (LISTEN state only) as JSON. |
| `list_power_plans` | Lists installed Windows power plans with their GUID, friendly name, and whether they are currently active. Returns JSON with the active GUID at the top. |
| `list_processes` | Lists running processes as JSON. Filter by name (substring, case-insensitive). Sort by 'memory' (default), 'private', 'cpu', 'threads', 'handles' or 'name'. Limit caps the result count (default 20, max 1000). Backed by NtQuerySystemInformation for a single-syscall enumeration with full per-process metrics. |
| `list_registry_key` | Lists sub-keys and values under a registry key as JSON. |
| `list_scheduled_tasks` | Lists scheduled tasks under the given folder (default = root '\') via schtasks /Query. Returns JSON: Path, Name, State, LastRunTimeUtc, LastTaskResult, Enabled. |
| `list_services` | Lists Windows services as JSON. Filter by name substring (case-insensitive) and/or by status: Running, Stopped, Paused, StartPending, StopPending. |
| `list_tcp_connections` | Lists active TCP/IPv4 connections (Local/Remote address+port, state, owning PID) as JSON. Optional state filter (Listen, Established, CloseWait, TimeWait, Closed, SynSent, etc.). |
| `list_windows` | Lists all visible top-level windows as JSON. |
| `mem_allocate` | Allocates virtual memory in a remote process via VirtualAllocEx. Returns the base address of the new region. protect: 'rw' (PAGE_READWRITE), 'rwx' (PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE), 'rx' (PAGE_EXECUTE_READ). |
| `mem_dump_region` | Reads up to MAX_DUMP_BYTES (4 MiB) from a memory region and writes them to a host-side file (default: %TEMP%\winclean_mcp_dump_<pid>_<addr>.bin). Returns the path and sha256 of the dump. Suspends the target during the read if suspend=true (avoids torn pages). |
| `mem_enable_debug_privilege` | Enables SeDebugPrivilege on the current MCP process so subsequent OpenProcess calls can attach to protected processes (most non-PPL user-mode targets). Idempotent — safe to call repeatedly. |
| `mem_free` | Releases a region previously allocated with MemAllocate (MEM_RELEASE). |
| `mem_get_module_base` | Returns the base address and size of a named module in a process. Name comparison is case-insensitive. Returns the first match. |
| `mem_list_modules` | Lists all loaded modules (DLLs + EXE) of a process. Returns name, baseAddress, and sizeOfImage for each module. |
| `mem_list_processes` | Lists running processes filtered by name substring (case-insensitive). Returns pid, name, and sessionId for each match. Leave nameFilter empty to list all processes (capped at 512). |
| `mem_protect` | Changes page protection on a memory region via VirtualProtectEx. Returns the previous protection flags. protect: rw \| rwx \| rx \| ro \| noaccess. |
| `mem_query_region` | Queries the virtual memory region containing the given address via VirtualQueryEx. Returns BaseAddress, RegionSize, State (Free/Reserve/Commit), Protect flags, and Type (Private/Image/Mapped). |
| `mem_read_bytes` | Reads raw bytes from a process's virtual address space via ReadProcessMemory. Length is capped at 65536 bytes. Returns hex-encoded bytes in the 'hex' field. |
| `mem_read_c_string` | Reads a null-terminated ASCII C-string from a process's virtual memory. Stops at the first NUL byte or maxLength bytes, whichever comes first. |
| `mem_read_double` | Reads a 64-bit IEEE 754 double (little-endian) from a process's virtual memory. |
| `mem_read_float` | Reads a 32-bit IEEE 754 float (little-endian) from a process's virtual memory. |
| `mem_read_int32` | Reads a signed 32-bit integer (little-endian) from a process's virtual memory. |
| `mem_read_int64` | Reads a signed 64-bit integer (little-endian) from a process's virtual memory. |
| `mem_read_utf16` | Reads a null-terminated UTF-16LE wide string from a process's virtual memory. Stops at the first NUL char or maxChars characters, whichever comes first. |
| `mem_resume_process` | Resumes every thread of the target process via NtResumeProcess. |
| `mem_scan_aob` | Scans a module's memory range for an IDA-style byte pattern (Array-of-Bytes scan). Pattern format: hex bytes separated by spaces, '??' as wildcard. Example: '48 8B 05 ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 89 01'. Reads the module in 256 KiB chunks. Returns up to maxHits matching addresses. |
| `mem_scan_value_int32` | Cheat-Engine-style first scan: searches every committed RW page of the process for a 4-byte little-endian int32 value. Returns up to maxHits absolute addresses. Use MemReadInt32 to verify, then narrow via repeated scans. |
| `mem_suspend_process` | Suspends every thread of the target process via NtSuspendProcess. |
| `mem_write_bytes` | Writes raw bytes to a process's virtual memory via WriteProcessMemory. hex format: continuous hex digits (e.g. '48895c2408') or space-separated ('48 89 5c 24 08'). Length capped at 65536. Requires PROCESS_VM_WRITE — call MemEnableDebugPrivilege first for protected targets. |
| `mem_write_double` | Writes a 64-bit IEEE 754 double to a process's memory. |
| `mem_write_float` | Writes a 32-bit IEEE 754 float to a process's memory. |
| `mem_write_int32` | Writes a signed 32-bit little-endian integer to a process's memory. |
| `mem_write_int64` | Writes a signed 64-bit little-endian integer to a process's memory. |
| `microsoft_code_sample_search` | Search for official Microsoft / Azure code snippets and examples. Use before writing code (find a working pattern to follow) or after errors (compare your code against a known-good sample). Optional language filter narrows results to a single SDK ecosystem. |
| `microsoft_docs_fetch` | Fetch and convert a Microsoft documentation page into markdown format. Use after `microsoft_docs_search` when an excerpt is cut off or you need the full tutorial / configuration guide / API reference page. |
| `microsoft_docs_search` | Search official Microsoft documentation and return up to 10 concise, high-quality content chunks (max 500 tokens each), including title, URL and excerpt. Use first to get a quick, reliable overview of any Microsoft / Azure / .NET / Windows / M365 / Power Platform technology. |
| `mouse_drag_to` | Performs a mouse drag from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2) with intermediate cursor moves so the OS drag-recognition logic actually fires (some apps reject teleported clicks). button: 'left' \| 'right' \| 'middle'. steps: number of intermediate move events (default 20). |
| `mouse_move_smooth` | Moves the mouse cursor smoothly along an interpolated path. Useful when the target window inspects MOUSEMOVE deltas (anti-automation heuristics) instead of a teleport via SetCursorPos. No button is pressed. |
| `move` | Moves the mouse cursor to the given screen coordinates. Set drag=true to perform a left-button drag from the current position to the target. |
| `move_path` | Moves or renames a file or directory. |
| `multi_edit` | Types the same text into multiple UIA elements identified by exact Name property. Takes a comma-separated label list and a single text payload. Resolves labels against a fresh Snapshot() of the foreground window. |
| `multi_select` | Clicks multiple UI elements identified by exact UIA Name property. Takes a comma-separated label list. Returns a JSON summary of clicked / notFound. Resolves labels against a fresh Snapshot() of the foreground window. |
| `n2b` | Scan and migrate a Node.js codebase to Bun using n2b. Detects Node-specific patterns, shims, polyfills, package configurations, and automatically migrates or fixes them. |
| `native_hooks` | Query native OS state (CPU count, memory usage, page size) directly via OS APIs, bypassing WMI or higher-level abstractions. |
| `nu_commands` | List Nushell commands with their descriptions, optionally filtered. |
| `nu_eval` | Evaluate Nushell code and return its value as JSON (tables are arrays of records). Pass data through `vars` (read as $env.<name>) instead of splicing it into code. External command output is captured, stdout then stderr. |
| `nu_help` | Full help of one Nushell command: signature, flags, examples. |
| `perf_dwm_flush` | Forces the Desktop Window Manager to flush pending GPU work (DwmFlush). Useful right before / after a frame-rate critical operation to align with VBLANK. |
| `perf_empty_working_sets` | Trims the working set of EVERY accessible process via NtSetSystemInformation (MemoryEmptyWorkingSets). Each process keeps its memory but pages are pushed to standby, freeing physical RAM immediately. No process is killed. |
| `perf_memory_status` | Returns current physical and virtual memory pressure (MEMORYSTATUSEX). Use before/after PerfPurgeStandbyList or PerfEmptyWorkingSets to measure impact. |
| `perf_purge_standby_list` | Purges the Windows memory standby list (cached pages that are no longer in any working set but kept around for re-use). Frees RAM instantly without touching working sets. Equivalent to RAMMap → Empty Standby List. Requires elevation. |
| `perf_set_eco_mode` | Toggles Win11 EcoQoS (PowerThrottling) on a process. EcoMode = on  → process is throttled to E-cores and capped frequency (saves power). EcoMode = off → release throttling (max performance). Reset all overrides with mode='default'. |
| `photoshop_action_json` | Play an actionJSON program (a recorded Photoshop action set as JSON) over a PSD/image via the cloud Photoshop API (documentOperations). `actions` is the actionJSON array. Returns the job JSON. |
| `photoshop_auto_straighten` | Auto-straighten (Upright perspective correction) via the cloud Lightroom API. input_url readable, output_url writable. Returns the job JSON. |
| `photoshop_auto_tone` | Auto-tone an image via the cloud Lightroom API (AI exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, vibrance). input_url readable by Adobe; output_url writable. format = png\|jpg\|psd\|tiff\|dng. Job JSON. |
| `photoshop_create_mask` | Create a subject/background alpha mask for an image (Sensei mask). input_url readable, output_url writable. Returns the job JSON. |
| `photoshop_depth_blur` | Depth-of-field blur via the cloud Photoshop API (depthBlur Neural Filter). input_url readable, output_url writable. Returns the job JSON. |
| `photoshop_document_operations` | Apply layer edits (and optionally render) on a PSD via the cloud Photoshop API (documentOperations). `options` is the layer-edit JSON tree. Returns the job JSON. |
| `photoshop_edit` | Apply explicit Camera-Raw adjustments via the cloud Lightroom API (edit): exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, temperature, tint, vibrance, saturation, clarity, dehaze, texture, sharpness. Only the set fields are applied. Returns the job JSON. |
| `photoshop_live_batchplay` | Run a batchPlay command array inside the RUNNING Photoshop (in-app UXP plugin) — the universal driver for ANY Photoshop operation (the same ActionDescriptor JSON ScriptListener/Alchemist emit). `commands` is the array; `options` is optional. Returns { ok, result } with batchPlay's response descriptors. Requires the aphrody UXP panel loaded. |
| `photoshop_live_exec` | Evaluate arbitrary UXP JavaScript inside the RUNNING Photoshop (in-app plugin) with app/photoshop/constants/core/batchPlay in scope — full internal access for anything not expressible as one batchPlay array. `return` a JSON-serializable value. Requires the aphrody UXP panel loaded. |
| `photoshop_live_info` | Report the running Photoshop's state via the in-app UXP plugin: app version, active document (name, dimensions, mode), and the layer tree. Requires the aphrody UXP panel loaded in Photoshop. Returns { ok, result }. |
| `photoshop_manifest` | Get the layer manifest (tree, dimensions, mode) of a PSD/image via the cloud Photoshop API. input_url must be readable by Adobe (presigned S3 / Azure SAS / Dropbox / Creative Cloud). Returns the Photoshop job JSON. |
| `photoshop_product_crop` | Content-aware product crop via the cloud Photoshop API (productCrop). input_url readable, output_url writable. Returns the job JSON. |
| `photoshop_remove_background` | Remove the background of an image (Sensei cutout), returning a transparent cut-out. input_url readable, output_url writable (png recommended). Returns the job JSON. |
| `photoshop_rendition` | Render a PSD/image to an output URL via the cloud Photoshop API (renditionCreate). format = png\|jpg\|psd\|tiff\|dng. output_url must be a writable destination (presigned PUT / SAS / CC). Returns the job JSON. |
| `power_shell` | Executes a PowerShell command and returns stdout, stderr, exit code, and duration as JSON. Uses pwsh (PowerShell 7) when available, falling back to powershell.exe. Captures both streams without launching a window. |
| `query_event_log` | Queries a Windows Event Log channel via wevtapi and returns up to maxEvents entries (newest first) as JSON. Optional XPath filter (e.g. "*[System[Level=2]]" for Error-level only). Channel examples: Application, System, Security, Microsoft-Windows-WindowsUpdateClient/Operational. |
| `re_disasm` | Disassemble x86-64 instructions from a binary file (PE, ELF, raw shellcode, firmware dump — any byte sequence). Returns a JSON object with `path`, `offset`, `rip`, `limit`, `count`, and an `instructions` array. Each instruction entry contains `offset` (byte offset from the start of the decoded slice), `address` (virtual address = rip + offset), `bytes_hex` (lowercase hex of raw instruction bytes), `mnemonic` (bare mnemonic, e.g. `"mov"`), and `text` (full Intel-syntax line, e.g. `"mov rbp,rsp"`). Decoding stops at the instruction limit, the end of the slice, or the first invalid/unknown encoding — whichever comes first. Errors with a structured envelope on read failure, oversized inputs (> 100 MB), or out-of-bounds offset. |
| `re_sections` | Parse a PE32/PE64/ELF32/ELF64 binary and return its section table as a JSON object. Each entry contains `name` (string), `vaddr` (u64), `size` (u64 bytes on disk), and `entropy` (Shannon bits/byte, null for .bss-style sections with no on-disk content). High entropy (>= 7.0) signals compression or encryption (UPX, custom packers). Returns a structured envelope on read failure, oversized inputs, or unknown binary formats. |
| `re_strings` | Extract printable ASCII and UTF-16LE strings from any file (binary, firmware, PE, ELF, data blob). Returns a JSON object with `path`, `min_len`, `limit`, and a `strings` array of deduplicated runs. Works on any file format — no binary parsing required. Errors with a structured envelope on read failure or if the file exceeds 100 MB. |
| `re_triage` | Triage a binary file (PE32/PE64/ELF32/ELF64): detect format via magic, parse with goblin, extract sections with per-section Shannon entropy, imports, exports, ASCII/UTF-16LE strings sample (≤ 64 entries, min length 6), and a SHA-256 fingerprint. Pure Rust, no GPL deps. Returns a TriageReport JSON object. Errors with structured envelope on read failures or oversized inputs. |
| `read_file` | Reads a UTF-8 text file. Supports optional line offset and limit for reading large files in chunks. Returns the content prefixed with the resolved absolute path. |
| `resize_window` | Resizes / moves a window matched by title substring. Set width/height to 0 to keep current size. |
| `restart_service` | Restarts a Windows service. Stops then starts, waiting up to 10s per phase. |
| `run_scheduled_task` | Runs a scheduled task immediately via schtasks /Run. |
| `runtime_resolve` | Resolve Bun, uv and Nushell: path, source, installed version, repository pin, pin compliance and Aphrody Bun module version when present |
| `scrape` | Fetches a URL via HTTP GET and returns extracted plain text (script/style stripped, tags removed). Caps: 4 MiB download, 200k extracted chars, 30s timeout. For richer extraction prefer the docs MCP server (microsoft_docs_fetch / winclean_universal_web_fetch). |
| `screen_capture` | Capture the whole primary screen (or a window by title substring) as a PNG and return it base64-encoded so a vision model can see it. Optionally also save to disk. Local-only. Returns { mime, bytes, base64, saved_path }. |
| `screenshot` | Captures the primary monitor to a BMP file on disk. Returns the absolute file path. Width/height default to the full virtual screen. |
| `scroll` | Scrolls at the given screen coordinates. axis: 'vertical' \| 'horizontal'. direction: up/down for vertical, left/right for horizontal. wheelTimes is the number of wheel notches (each notch ≈ 3 lines). |
| `search_files` | Searches a directory tree for files matching a glob pattern. Hard cap: 10000 results; result is marked truncated when exceeded. |
| `search_windows` | Effectue une recherche ultra-rapide sur le disque via l'indexeur natif Windows Search. |
| `send_notification` | Displays a Windows tray balloon notification with title and message. Note: balloon tips replace classic Win32 toasts; modern WinRT toast (requires WindowsAppSDK projection) is not yet wired up. |
| `set_active_power_plan` | Activates a Windows power plan by GUID. Common GUIDs: 381b4222-f694-41f0-9685-ff5bb260df2e (Balanced), 8c5e7fda-e8bf-4a96-9a85-a6e23a8c635c (High performance), a1841308-3541-4fab-bc81-f71556f20b4a (Power saver), e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61 (Ultimate Performance). |
| `set_clipboard_text` | Writes UTF-16 text to the Windows clipboard. |
| `set_gpu_preference` | Writes per-app GPU preference in HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences. preference: 'SystemDefault' (0), 'PowerSaving' (1, iGPU), 'HighPerformance' (2, dGPU). exePath should be the absolute path to the .exe. Takes effect on next process launch. Format written: REG_SZ 'GpuPreference=N;'. |
| `set_hags_mode` | Writes HwSchMode in HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers. Valid: 0 (WDDM CPU), 1 (OS default), 2 (HW-accelerated GPU scheduling). Requires admin + reboot. Microsoft + NVIDIA recommend 2 on WDDM 2.7+ hardware (validates DLSS 3 Frame Generation). |
| `set_process_affinity` | Sets the CPU affinity mask of a process. The mask is a bitmask where bit N means 'process may run on logical processor N'. Pass 0 to reset to the system default. Returns previous and new mask in hex as JSON. |
| `set_process_priority` | Sets the Windows priority class of a process. Valid values: 'Idle', 'BelowNormal', 'Normal', 'AboveNormal', 'High', 'Realtime'. Returns previous and new class as JSON. Realtime requires Administrator and can starve system services. |
| `set_registry_value` | Writes a registry value. Creates the key if missing. Supported types: String, ExpandString, DWord, QWord, MultiString (newline-separated). |
| `shortcut` | Sends a keyboard shortcut. The combo is a '+'-separated list of keys, e.g. 'ctrl+c', 'ctrl+shift+esc', 'win+r', 'alt+f4'. Modifier keys: ctrl, shift, alt, win. Literal keys: a-z, 0-9, f1-f24, esc, enter, tab, space, backspace, delete, home, end, up, down, left, right. |
| `snapshot` | Captures a UIA control-view tree snapshot of the foreground window via native UI Automation. Pass windowHandle to inspect a specific application without changing focus. Returns up to maxElements (default 200) descendants with name, controlType, automationId, className, bounds, focus and enabled state. Used by computer_* and MultiSelect/MultiEdit. |
| `start_dashboard` | Start a loopback HTTP server exposing live telemetry about THIS MCP process: GET /health (liveness) and GET /info (PID, uptime, memory, and a counter of /info hits). Binds 127.0.0.1 only - set APHRODY_MCP_DASHBOARD_HOST to widen it deliberately. Runs in the background for the lifetime of the MCP process and cannot be stopped by a tool call. |
| `start_service` | Starts a stopped Windows service. Waits up to 10s for the Running state. |
| `steam_get_game` | Returns full details of a single Steam game by appId. Returns {"success":false,...} if the appId is not found. |
| `steam_get_game_status` | Checks whether a Steam game process is currently running. Resolves install_dir and absolute_install_path from steam-scan.db. Executable name defaults to install_dir + ".exe". Returns {"appId":N,"running":bool,"pid":N\|null,"executable":"...","installDir":"..."}. |
| `steam_kill_game` | Kills a running Steam game by executable name. Returns {"success":true,"pid":N,"killed":1} or {"success":false,"error":"not running"}. |
| `steam_launch_and_wait` | Launches a Steam game via steam://rungameid/{appId} then waits for the process to appear. Combines SteamLaunchByAppId + SteamWaitForLaunch in a single MCP call. Returns {"success":true,"pid":N,"elapsedMs":N} or {"success":false,...}. |
| `steam_launch_by_app_id` | Launches a Steam game via steam://rungameid/{appId}. Returns immediately — use SteamWaitForLaunch to block until the process is alive. Returns {"success":false,...} if Steam is not installed. |
| `steam_list_games` | Returns a JSON array of Steam games from steam-scan.db. By default only games whose files are present on disk (files_present > 0) are returned. Set includeMissing=true to include all rows regardless of files_present. |
| `steam_list_libraries` | Returns all Steam library paths with their game_count and total_size_bytes as recorded in steam-scan.db. |
| `steam_open_uri` | Opens any steam:// URI via ShellExecute. Allowed schemes: steam:// only. Returns {"success":true,"uri":"..."} or {"success":false,"error":"invalid scheme"}. |
| `steam_scan_summary` | Returns aggregate counts from steam-scan.db: nb_installs, nb_libraries, nb_games, nb_games_present, total_size_bytes. |
| `steam_vault_status` | Returns vault target metadata from secrets_vault_ref (target name, kind, description, user_hint). Secret material (passwords, tokens) is never included. Also attempts to invoke 'winclean-steam-auth list --json' (if present) for live vault status. |
| `steam_wait_for_launch` | Polls until the named process appears or the timeout elapses. Returns {"success":true,"pid":N,"elapsedMs":N} or {"success":false,"error":"timeout",...}. |
| `stop_service` | Stops a running Windows service. Waits up to 10s for the Stopped state. |
| `switch_to_window` | Brings a window to the foreground by partial title match (case-insensitive). Restores it if minimized. |
| `sync_external_agents` | Mirror the sessions of the other coding agents on this machine (Antigravity CLI `agy`, Codex, Claude Code) into ~/.aphrody/sessions/<agent>/<session_id>.jsonl, incrementally: per-file byte offsets mean a re-run only ingests lines appended since, and each line is normalised to {agent, session_id, workspace, ts, role, text, source_path, offset}. Optionally matches running agent processes to the sessions they write (live, default true) and feeds user/assistant turns into the local memory store (memory, default true). Returns the JSON summary { records_ingested, sources_scanned, sources_updated, agents, sessions, live_processes, memory, issues }. |
| `systemd_journal_query` | Query log messages from systemd journald with unit, severity level, and limit filtering |
| `systemd_list_units` | List all active and configured systemd units, targets and services |
| `systemd_load_unit_file` | Load and register a new systemd unit from INI text content |
| `systemd_reload_unit` | Reload configuration for a systemd service |
| `systemd_restart_unit` | Restart a systemd service |
| `systemd_start_unit` | Start or activate a systemd service or target |
| `systemd_stop_unit` | Stop or deactivate a systemd service or target |
| `systemd_unit_status` | Get detailed status, state, PID, uptime, and dependencies of a specific systemd unit |
| `trim_process_working_set` | DIAGNOSTIC / DEBUG ONLY. Trims a process's working set via SetProcessWorkingSetSize(-1,-1). The OS does NOT free the pages — it moves them to the standby list. The next time the process touches that memory, it incurs a HARD PAGE FAULT (disk read). Mark Russinovich (Sysinternals creator, Azure CTO) documents this is anti-performance for normal use: see 'The Memory-Optimization Hoax'. The Microsoft API doc itself states the function is 'useful primarily for testing and tuning'. Use only on demonstrably-idle GUI apps where you accept the next-touch latency. Do NOT call in a loop. |
| `type` | Types text at the given screen coordinates. Set clear=true to send Ctrl+A + Delete before typing. Set pressEnter=true to submit with RETURN after typing. Max 4096 chars per call. |
| `universal_web_fetch` | Fetch any webpage from the internet and convert it to clean Markdown. Fetched directly by aphrody and converted in-process (no third-party reader). Highly recommended for reading online developer documentation, issue trackers, or tutorials. |
| `uutils_catalog` | List supported pinned uutils companion utilities and their availability |
| `uutils_run` | Run a pinned uutils companion utility (find, grep, sed, diff, or tar) without a shell |
| `voice_synthesize` | Synthesise speech from text via the aphrody-voice ElevenLabs adapter. Returns { audio_base64, mime_type, duration_ms, bytes, voice }. Requires ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in env. |
| `voice_transcribe` | Transcribe base64-encoded audio via aphrody-voice-stt. Prefers offline whisper.cpp (set APHRODY_WHISPER_MODEL to a GGML model path); falls back to the OpenAI Whisper REST API (OPENAI_API_KEY) — so this tool MAY upload the audio; use `aphrody_transcribe` (feature stt-local) when it must not leave the machine. Returns { text, confidence, confidence_note, language, duration_s, segments, backend, mime_type }. `confidence` is always null: neither backend reports one and this tool does not invent one. |
| `wait` | Pauses execution for the given duration in seconds (1..120). |
| `window_capture` | Captures the pixels of a window to a 24-bit BMP file via PrintWindow + GetDIBits. Works even when the window is MINIMISED, OFF-SCREEN or COVERED by another window (DWM redirection surface). Returns the saved BMP path and dimensions. |
| `window_close` | Sends WM_CLOSE to the window (graceful close request). |
| `window_enum_all` | Enumerates every top-level window (visible AND hidden). Filters by pid (0 = any), class substring, title substring (all case-insensitive). Returns hwnd, pid, classname, title, rect, visible, minimised, maximised flags. |
| `window_enum_children` | Enumerates direct + indirect child windows of a given HWND parent. Useful to drill into controls inside an app frame (edit fields, buttons, listviews). |
| `window_find_by_class` | Finds the first top-level HWND with the exact class name (case-sensitive) and optionally a matching window title. Returns hwnd=0 if not found. |
| `window_get_text` | Reads the text of a window or control via WM_GETTEXTLENGTH + WM_GETTEXT. Works on hidden controls; pair with WindowEnumChildren to locate the HWND. |
| `window_minimise_all` | Sends WM_KEYDOWN/UP for Win+D to the shell — minimises every visible window at once. |
| `window_move` | Moves and/or resizes a window by HWND. Set width/height to 0 to keep current size, set x/y to a value outside the visible desktop to park the window off-screen. |
| `window_post_message` | Posts a Win32 message to a window's queue via PostMessageW (asynchronous, non-blocking). Returns immediately even if the target ignores or hangs on the message. |
| `window_send_message` | Sends a Win32 message to a window via SendMessageW (synchronous). Useful to drive controls without stealing focus — e.g. WM_LBUTTONDOWN/UP on a button HWND, WM_SETTEXT to set an edit field, WM_CLOSE to request close. wParam/lParam can be decimal or 0x-prefixed hex. |
| `window_set_opacity` | Sets per-window opacity (0..255). Promotes the window to WS_EX_LAYERED if needed. Use 255 = fully opaque, 0 = fully transparent (but still receives input unless clickThrough). |
| `window_set_text` | Sets the text of a window or control via WM_SETTEXT. Targets edit fields, captions, listbox items. For complex Unicode UIs prefer UIA. |
| `window_set_topmost` | Sets the TOPMOST flag on a window (Z-order pinned above all non-topmost windows). |
| `winml_get_version` | Returns the ONNX Runtime version string powering Windows ML on this machine. |
| `winml_inspect_onnx` | Loads an ONNX model and returns its input/output metadata (name, element type, shape). Use this before WinmlRunFloat32 to discover tensor shapes. |
| `winml_list_providers` | Lists ONNX Runtime execution providers available in the current process (e.g. CPUExecutionProvider, DmlExecutionProvider, CUDAExecutionProvider). Reflects whatever EPs Windows ML / the loaded native dll registered. |
| `winml_run_float32` | Runs inference on an ONNX model with float32 tensor inputs. inputsJson: '{"input_name":{"shape":[1,3,224,224],"data":[0.1,0.2,...]}}'. executionProvider: 'cpu' (default) \| 'dml' (DirectML, any GPU) \| 'cuda' (NVIDIA). Returns the first output tensor as float32 JSON. |
| `write_file` | Writes UTF-8 text to a file. Creates parent directories as needed. Set append=true to append instead of overwrite. |
| `wsl_execute` | Runs a command in an existing WSL distribution using an argv array, with a 30-second bound and captured stdout/stderr. command must contain the executable followed by arguments; it is never concatenated into a shell command. For deliberate shell scripting, pass /bin/sh, -lc, and the script as separate command entries. |
| `wsl_get_status` | Returns the local WSL installation status. This is read-only and reports the Windows WSL configuration, default distribution, and kernel information when available. |
| `wsl_list_distributions` | Lists installed WSL distributions with their state and WSL version. This is read-only; it never starts, terminates, imports, exports, or unregisters a distribution. |
| `wsl_list_processes` | Lists Linux processes in an existing WSL distribution. This is read-only and returns PID, parent PID, command, and arguments. |
| `wsl_read_only_probe` | Runs one fixed, read-only diagnostic inside an existing WSL distribution. probe must be one of: system-info, re-toolchain, processes, mounts, or network. No arbitrary shell command is accepted. |
| `wsl_send_signal` | Sends HUP, INT, TERM, or KILL to one exact Linux PID in an existing WSL distribution. Call wsl_list_processes first to identify the target PID. |
| `skill_bun_docs_lookup` | Skill (bun_docs): Answer a Bun question from the vendored docs: ranked pages plus the best page's Markdown. Steps: bun_docs_search. |
| `skill_largest_files` | Skill (shell): The 20 largest files directly under a directory, largest first. Steps: nu_eval. |
| `skill_system_snapshot` | Skill (shell): Host, CPU, memory and disk facts, plus the 10 busiest processes. Steps: nu_eval. |
| `skill_systemd_inspect` | Skill (systemd): Check status of systemd units and query recent system warnings or errors Steps: systemd_list_units -> systemd_journal_query. |
